'''Belga Daeri''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she resided in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and served as a [[Kachirho Starport|spaceport]] official.<ref name="SWG:BD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> A band of [[Asteroid Bandits|pirates]] led by [[Dorn Nareusu]] raided and destroyed numerous [[Transport/Legends|transport ships]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. After several weeks of rampage, the pirates had seriously disturbed the civilian traffic in the system. Belga Daeri therefore contacted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bounty/Legends|Bounty]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Stren Colo]] and placed a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on Dorn Nareusu.<ref name="SWG:BD" /> A group of pilots later attacked Nareusu's cohorts in the Kashyyyk system<ref name="SWG:DDC">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=space|Destroy Dorn's Cohorts|Kashyyyk system}}</ref> and eventually killed Dorn Nareusu in the ensuring fight.<ref name="SWG:DA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=space|Dorn's arrival|Kashyyyk system}}</ref>
